summary: D1 removes cadence from the project tooling schema, checker, tests, and dogfood manifest because routine and on_demand state when an agent should select a command and therefore cross CD-0043 D1's host-owned methodology boundary; the remaining fields describe identity, invocation, cost, and referenced repository files without a selection schedule; D2 replaces an optional jsonschema test, which CI could skip, with direct standard-library comparison of the checker's contract constants against the published schema; D3 changes accepted law by narrowly superseding CD-0074's cadence clauses while preserving its path-containment rules and probe-family exclusion.
title: A tooling inventory excludes command-selection cadence
